subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB508
title: Prohibits insurers from using any device or technology that records, discloses or allows access to information that tracks or reveals the geographic location of an insured during any time in which the insured is occupying or operating a motor vehicle that the motor vehicle liability insurance policy covers.
headline: SB 508 did not pass

claims.text: SB 508 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
SB 508 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
